purpose_context: Missions in repos that do not use a src/ layout (Django apps/, Go internal/) currently fail the accept path-convention gate and are told to fabricate an empty directory. This mission adds a project-level path_conventions override so operators declare their real layout once in .kittify/config.yaml and accept honors it — resolved ahead of mission-type doctrine defaults, without weakening the blocking-by-default policy the honesty mission (#3783) just established.
purpose_tldr: Let a project declare its real source layout so accept stops failing non-src repos.
